display_long_description:
Step into the wild… if you dare. RTX Scary Baboon plunges you directly into a chaotic VR landscape where danger lurks behind every tree. This isn't your average walk in the woods—it's a fight for survival in a primitive world gone completely mad.

Transform your experience with unique modifications that warp the environment into something far more sinister. No two playthroughs are ever identical. Navigate through suffocating, shadow-drenched territories where your eyes will constantly play tricks on you. Push your adrenaline to the limit during frantic, heart-stopping chases that demand split-second reactions.

Every single mod introduces a brand-new element of tension—ranging from disturbing aesthetic overhauls and sudden jump scares to entirely overhauled mechanics. Can you handle the panic, or will the jungle claim you?
